- Option B: split into two focused sessions (30-min SOC 2 overview + 30-min pen-test intake) — Jul 7, 09:00-09:30 PT and Jul 7, 09:45-10:15 PT
- Option C: evening-friendly slot for APAC overlap — Jul 12, 16:30-17:30 PT (if you need APAC folks)

1) Can you confirm who (names/emails) on Finly side will attend?
2) Any regulatory lenses we should prioritize (e.g., PCI scope, HIPAA)?

I'm attaching our SOC2 intake template to speed prep. I'll set tentative calendar holders once you pick an option. We'll provide a dedicated Zoom + an Ops bridge for the pen-test handshake.

Quick follow-up from my side — happy to compress the session if Finly can pre-share the vendor questionnaire answers and an inventory snapshot (S3 buckets, DB hosts, CIDs). My suggested agenda for a compact two-session flow:

- Session 1 (30 min): High-level architecture, trust boundaries, data classification, and SOC 2 control mapping (I cover control owners/answers)
- Prework: Finly uploads questionnaire & evidence pointers to the Drive folder (I'll share a template)
- Session 2 (30 min): Pen-test intake and operational readiness — scope, allowed test windows, blacklist, and access model

I'm available Jul 7 AM PT for the split flow. Thoughts?
